up: Retrieve up to 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human target CHEMBL1743128 (ATP-binding cassette sub-family C member 4). For each row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Only include rows where the standard relation is exactly '=', pChEMBL value is non-null, and the target is a single protein in Homo sapiens. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
    a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    act.standard_type,
    act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1743128'
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND act.standard_relation = '='
    AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
ORDER BY
    md.chembl_id,
    a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
